summary: Round 2 closes 3 of the 4 Round 1 issues. The retraction-pattern fix is genuine rather than merely cosmetic: v0.2 now consistently restores Sub-Q4 attribution to `[UNKNOWN]`, marks `S4` as retracted instead of live, and aligns with FINDINGS v2 / RETRACTION / `gap_shape_g4_1.md` that attribution is blocked pending a real Sub-Q3 upgrade. The prefactor-number correction and the T1 scope caveat are also now source-faithful. One major issue remains, though: the C1/C2/C3 upgrade invariant is still not stated consistently across the document, so the Round 1 upgrade-path issue is not fully closed.

issues.description: The Round 1 C1/C2/C3 invariant fix is incomplete. Section 7 is now correct, but this sentence still says that any Log 07 path becomes upgradable once it is `由用户形式化`, which reads as if user formalization alone is sufficient for upgrading the umr converse. That conflicts with CLAUDE.md R0.2 and `research-rigor.md` R2.2, which require `C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3` together for any `[COROLLARY]`/`[THM]` upgrade. Because this leftover wording sits in the main Sub-Q3 conclusion, the document still presents an inconsistent upgrade rule.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the sentence to separate the technical prerequisite from the rigor upgrade. For example: formalizing any one of α/β/γ may close the technical converse gap, but upgrading the claim’s rigor level still separately requires `C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3`.

round_recommendation: Tighten the remaining `可升级` wording in §4/§5 so every upgrade reference matches the `C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3` invariant, then re-run review. None of the other Round 1 issues need reopening.
